phases: Compile and create selected callable before argument callbacks; transfer code ownership from Entry_Code into an actual Current.Arguments closure prefix.

Second tiny C callback retains/returns closure, same table, and luaL_len result; Ada validates/reserves count. No C arg-copy loop.
Keep closure/table/length in Current.Arguments, transactionally reserve, meter raw-copy slots1..n, then remove metadata only after actual callee/arguments root publication.

Use existing Function_Value driver start with actual compiled closure and argument values; final pin/epoch ordering must be proved before any prefix clear. Normal completion/error/exit/host-abort cleanup.
